title: Geoeconomic Monitor: Summit Season

Geoeconomic Monitor: Summit Season

Tom Holland, Tom Miller

Gavekal Research | 18 Sep 2026

Leaders from the Gulf Arab states are scheduled to meet Donald Trump Tuesday on the sidelines of the United Nations General Assembly in New York. If they cannot get any clarity from the US president on when they will be able to resume uninterrupted energy exports, they will increasingly look elsewhere for economic security, argues Tom Holland, even to the extent of seeking an independent deal with Iran. Then, after meeting the Gulf leaders Tuesday, Trump is due to sit down with Chinese president Xi Jinping in Washington Thursday. Tom Miller looks at what will be up for discussion, and what the summit is likely to deliver.In this issue:
